text:
Alex: FYI rolling 560.3 to canary GPUs triggered a small but repeatable boot failure. 8 nodes failed to finish boot in us-west2 and ap-southeast, now in provisioning stuck state. pausing rollout.

Alex: logs from one affected node:
```
[   12.345678] pci 0000:65:00.0: can't claim BAR 14: mmio at 0x0 [size=0x40000000]
[   13.001234] nvidia: loading out-of-tree module taints kernel
[   13.002345] nvidia: module license 'NVIDIA' taints kernel.
[   13.234567] nvidia_uvm: loading module.
[   16.999999] nvidia: probe of 0000:65:00.0 failed with error -110
[   17.000123] Initramfs: waiting for /dev/nvidiactl timed out

DKMS build snippet:
ERROR (dkms apport): kernel package linux-headers-5.15.0-101-generic is not supported
Error! Bad return status for module build on kernel: 5.15.0-101-generic (x86_64)
Consult /var/lib/dkms/nvidia/560.3/build/make.log for more information
```

deploybot: `canary-rollout` paused by Alex — 8/120 nodes failed, affected pools: canary-gpu-us-west2, canary-gpu-ap-southeast

Maya: Ack. Kicking off repro in staging (same kernel image) and will attach serial logs. :eyes:

Sam: Is this related to the earlier 550/552 initramfs race? or new NV driver regression?

Li: Quick read — error -110 is a PCIe timeout (device not enumerating fully) + DKMS failing because header mismatch. Two failure classes: (1) driver probing/PCIe timing, (2) DKMS build mismatch causing modprobe to block waiting for correct module. Seems different than the initramfs deadlock we saw.

Nate: Can we get a node shell? list of affected instances would help. Alex, can you paste node IDs?

Alex: node ids: gpu-canary-uw2-07,gpu-canary-uw2-08,gpu-canary-as1-03,gpu-canary-as1-04,gpu-canary-as1-09,gpu-canary-uw2-11,gpu-canary-as1-12,gpu-canary-uw2-14

Maya: Repro on staging: same bootstrap -> udev waits on /dev/nvidiactl after modprobe stalls. grabbing full dmesg and /var/lib/dkms/*/make.log

Li: Short-term mitigations:
- Pause/rollback rollout (done)
- For immediate in-flight node recovery: chroot into initramfs and ensure linux-headers for current kernel present OR skip DKMS and load prebuilt module from artifact cache.
- Blacklist nouveau earlier in boot so driver probe doesn't race? might not help the PCIe timeout.

Sam: Can we rpm/apt install linux-headers-$(uname -r) as part of the provisioning recipe? If DKMS fails we should fallback to prebuilt packages we host.

Alex: Rolling back canary to 559.12 now. infra-cli command used:
```
infra-cli rollout rollback --pool canary-gpu --to-version 559.12 --reason "560.3 canary boot failures"
```

infra-bot: Rollback started; will drain failed nodes once they recover and repro tickets created.

Nate: Quick hotfix attempt: on one repro node I mounted the rootfs and:
```
# chroot /mnt/rootfs
apt-get update && apt-get install -y linux-headers-$(uname -r)
dkms autoinstall --verbose
update-initramfs -u -k $(uname -r)
reboot
```
Second node booted successfully after reinstalling headers + DKMS rebuild.

Maya: Good data point. Suggestion: add kernel-headers install to the distro bootstrap step for GPU nodes. Also add prebuilt-nvidia package fallback in our apt repo.

Li: I'll draft the bootstrap patch and a canary validation test that checks for /var/lib/dkms/<driver>/build/make.log not containing 'Bad return status'.

Sam: Also open a ticket with NVIDIA — attaching make.log + pci enumeration traces. This smells like a regression in 560.3 probing order on some firmware combos. tagging firmware team.

Alex: Created INFRA-2312 (NR: attach logs) and NV support case 122334 (case opened). Adding priority P1 until root cause confirmed.

Maya: For monitoring: I'm adding a short-term alert that marks node as unhealthy if it reports 'Initramfs: waiting for /dev/nvidiactl' for >180s during provisioning.

Nate: Heads-up: cost/ops note — rollback will increase churn and provisioning retries; estimate +12h of provisioning overhead for today, tracking on INFRA-2312.

Li: Plan of record:
1) Rollback canary (done)
2) Patch bootstrap to ensure linux-headers present and add prebuilt driver fallback (today)
3) Run a canary with staged kernel+driver combo in staging and prod (tomorrow)
4) If repro, escalate with NV with attachment (immediate)

Alex: Thanks. I'll keep thread updated. dropping a short checklist in INFRA-2312 and assigning owners.

Maya: I'll post back once staging repro logs uploaded. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Rollback completed — 8 nodes rolled back to 559.12, 6 nodes auto-recovered, 2 remained in provisioning (manual intervention required).

Sam: Follow-up: we should also scan fleet for nodes running kernel versions that commonly trigger DKMS mismatches (5.15.x and custom kernel builds) and add them to a preflight check before driver rollouts.

Alex: Agreed. Adding a preflight job to abort rollout if >1% of target pool lacks matching headers/artifacts.

Nate: I'll update runbook with the hotfix steps (install headers, dkms autoinstall, update-initramfs) and mark the emergency escalation path.

Alex: Closing for now — will reopen thread if we see failures post-patch.
